ModMetaData.name: Fallout 76 Soundtrack - French TradFix
ModMetaData.author: Raptor Ex Seven
ModMetaData.description:
Adds 40 songs from the Fallout 76 music Soundtrack and the trailer song Take Me Home, Country Roads by the band Spank. Includes 9 battle songs and 32 anytime songs.
This mod doesn't include any of the songs from the Fallout radio stations, only the ambient tracks and the trailer song.
All product names, logos, and brands are property of their respective owners. Thanks to Inon Zur and Spank for making the songs and thanks to Tynan Sylvester for making Rimworld.
